findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: unblock, instagram, google-maps, tiktok, youtube, twitter, reddit, amazon, google-search, google-maps-reviews, youtube-transcript, screenshot, linkedin-jobs, amazon-reviews, google-play-reviews, linkedin-company, web-search, x-replies, youtube-comments, tiktok-comments, instagram-comments, meta-ads, linkedin-profile-email, linkedin-posts, facebook-page, facebook-posts, facebook-comments, domain-contacts, maps-contacts, email-verify, search-plus · Private data: unblock, instagram, tiktok, reddit, google-search, linkedin-company, facebook-page, domain-contacts, maps-contacts · Public sink: unblock, instagram, linkedin, twitter, reddit, google-maps-reviews, youtube-transcript, screenshot, linkedin-jobs, indeed-jobs, shopify-products, google-news, amazon-reviews, google-play-reviews, linkedin-company, web-search, x-replies, youtube-comments, tiktok-comments, instagram-comments, ebay-sold, meta-ads, linkedin-profile-email, linkedin-posts, facebook-page, facebook-posts, facebook-comments, domain-contacts, maps-contacts, email-verify · Destructive: unblock, meta-ads, feedback.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
